scope: Four intervention coefficients. This is a source-passage audit, not validation of the full simulator or all city data.

rows.source: Ziter et al. 2019, PNAS; Manoli et al. 2024, Nature Communications
rows.claim: Daytime LST increase per 1 percentage-point loss of tree canopy cover. Central coefficient 0.09; range 0.06–0.12; units: °C per −1 pp canopy. Applied in Taap's Indian-city illustrative model, inherited from Bangalore where no override exists.
rows.locator: Ziter et al. 2019, article abstract and main text. This checks one listed source only; Manoli and any coefficient derivation still require review.
rows.note: Automated passage check only. A maintainer must review source applicability and coefficient derivation before treating this as scientific validation.
